description: Read only. The leads Taseli holds for the business (the last 90 days at most), newest first: when each came, its masked label (never a full name, phone or email in clear), its status (new, good, bad = not relevant, closed = became a customer, with the deal's worth), where it came from (a Google, Meta or TikTok form, WhatsApp, the website or CRM, an uploaded list, added by hand), the campaign, ad and form, and whether it was sent back to the ad platform. The form's answers come only for the owner, an admin or a manager. Useful for 'what leads came in?', 'show this week's leads', before marking one.

account.description: An ad account's name or id, to see one account only; omit for all of them.

cursor.description: From nextCursor of the previous answer, for the next page.

language.description: Answer language. The business's language by default.

name: leads_list

answers.description: The form's answers: only for the owner, an admin or a manager.

id.description: The lead's id, to mark it.

anyOf.description: Came from the form without an ad.

sentToPlatform.description: Sent back to the ad platform as a good lead or a deal.

source.description: google_form, meta_form, tiktok_form, csv, webhook, manual or whatsapp.

status.description: new, good, bad (not relevant) or closed (became a customer).

anyOf.description: What the deal was worth, for a customer.
A masked label the owner recognizes; never a full name, phone or email.
The `cursor` value for the next page; null at the end.

note.description: A plain note instead of data (nothing connected yet, not available here).

total.description: How many there are in all.

title: The business's leads
